description: Allye Agent Plugin — skill definitions for seeding into Allye DB

skills.name: using-allye
skills.description: Bootstrap meta-skill for AI agents using the Allye platform. Teaches when and how to use Allye MCP tools with structured workflows. Injected at session start.

skills.name: allye-memory-protocol
skills.description: Complete memory protocol for AI agents using Allye. Defines when and how to search, save, and link memories for cross-session continuity.

skills.name: allye-product-planning
skills.description: Workflow for translating business requirements into epics, features, and stories in Allye.

skills.name: allye-technical-planning
skills.description: Workflow for breaking a story into tasks through a structured discussion phase with decision capture.

skills.name: allye-technical-development
skills.description: Workflow for implementing tasks with TDD discipline, read-first rule, and wave execution.

skills.name: allye-technical-review
skills.description: Workflow for reviewing implemented code with decision context from planning phase.

skills.name: allye-technical-delivery
skills.description: Workflow for finalizing a story after all tasks pass review. Closes story, updates docs, cleans up.

skills.name: allye-tdd-workflow
skills.description: Test-Driven Development discipline for AI agents. Red-Green-Refactor cycle, detection heuristic, and anti-patterns.

skills.name: allye-board-progression
skills.description: Rules for moving work items between statuses in Allye boards. Covers work_status_next, work_status_done, and status categories.

skills.name: allye-tools-quickref
skills.description: Complete quick reference for all Allye MCP tools and their actions with parameters.

skills.name: handover-protocol
skills.description: The shared contract for handing off context between Allye workflow phases as copy-pasted chat text.
